title: ShieldCare Settlement Schedule: Repair Counts, Replacement Basis and the Depreciation Ladder
content:
## Part A: when a settlement turns from repair to replacement

| Plan | Repairs on the item after which the next approval is a replacement | Repairs of the same fault under the no-lemon rule | A replacement is valued at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | 3 | 3 | a current model of like features at the retailer's cost |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | 3 | 3 | a current model of like features at the retailer's cost |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | 2 | 2 | a current model of like features at the retailer's cost |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | 2 | 2 | a current model of like features at the retailer's cost, installation included |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | 3 | 3 | a current model of like capacity at the retailer's cost, delivery included |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | 2 | 2 | a current model of like features at the contract price book |

## Part B: depreciation taken off a cash reimbursement, percent, by the age of the item in whole months

| Item age | Essential Parts and Labour | Accidental Damage Plus | Total Device Protection | Home Theatre Premium | Major Appliance Extended Service | Business Fleet Protection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 to 12 months | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 13 to 24 months | 15 | 10 | 0 | 0 | 5 | 0 |
| 25 to 36 months | 30 | 25 | 15 | 10 | 15 | 8 |
| 37 to 48 months | 45 | 40 | 30 | 20 | 25 | 16 |
| beyond 48 months | 60 | 55 | 45 | 35 | 40 | 24 |

## Part C: the ceiling on a cash reimbursement, and how a settlement is paid

| Plan | Reimbursement ceiling, percent of the item purchase price | A settlement is paid by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | 70 | store credit |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | 80 | store credit |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | 100 | store credit or the card on file |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | 100 | store credit or the card on file |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | 85 | store credit |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | 100 | business invoice credit |

A Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan whose reimbursement ceiling is 100 percent still pays
no more than the item's own purchase price; the plans at 70 percent and 80 percent pay less
than that price even where no depreciation is taken off at all.
